name: continuous-learning-plugins
description: Personal collection of Claude Code plugins for knowledge management and development workflows

plugins.name: learning-vault
plugins.description: Capture technical learnings to Obsidian vault using Zettelkasten method. Integrates with Obsidian MCP server to create atomic, linked knowledge notes from development work.

plugins.name: anki-flashcards
plugins.description: Create Anki flashcards from conversation context for continuous learning with spaced repetition. Includes /flashcard command, quality review agent, and best practices skill.

plugins.name: learning-retrospective
plugins.description: Periodic learning analysis across Obsidian vault, Anki, and git history. Cross-references three data sources to surface topic clusters, retention gaps, connection suggestions, problem signals, and uncaptured work.

plugins.name: sraa-compliance
plugins.description: SRAA (Security Risk Assessment and Audit) compliance auditing for Hong Kong government/NGO security standards. Features specialized sub-agents with persistent context memory for comprehensive security assessments based on S17, G3, and ISPG-SM01 frameworks.

plugins.name: concept-challenger
plugins.description: Test concept application through novel scenarios with English writing feedback. Reads concepts from Obsidian vault, generates domain-rotated scenarios, and evaluates both concept understanding and technical writing quality.

plugins.name: production-audit
plugins.description: Production-grade software engineering audit plugin. Final gatekeeper before shipping to production — covers code quality, architecture, testing, performance, reliability, operations readiness, and feature-specific best practices via HyDE-powered research. Complements sraa-compliance for non-security engineering concerns.

plugins.name: doc-wiki
plugins.description: Analyze a codebase, extract features, design a Confluence wiki page tree, generate an implementation plan, and orchestrate documentation writing and publishing. Includes incremental update command for syncing docs after codebase changes. Integrates with atlassian MCP and code-documentation plugins.

plugins.name: cloud-infra-estimator
plugins.description: Analyzes a software system across multiple repos to estimate Azure cloud infrastructure requirements for a target scale (concurrent users). Scans Dockerfiles, k8s manifests, and IaC files to build a service topology, models load, sizes Azure SKUs across three tiers (min/recommended/peak), and outputs a formatted .xlsx report with cost estimates.

plugins.name: enterprise-deep-analysis
plugins.description: Wall Street-grade enterprise strategy and stock price deep analysis framework. Produces structured 5-chapter reports with competitive moat assessment, macro environment context, valuation modeling, catalyst calendar, risk matrix, and three-scenario price targets in Traditional Chinese.
